title: Farmers announce Delhi march and nationwide protests against CEC over SIR

tea.why: Farmers are protesting against the Special Intensive Revision of electoral rolls and demanding the resignation of the Chief Election Commissioner.
tea.want: Demanding the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar, the scrapping of the SIR, and changes to election commissioner selection.
tea.changed: Oct 16: Samyukt Kisan Morcha and All India Kisan Sabha announced a march to Delhi and nationwide district-level protests for October 23.

summary: Various farmers' organisations operating under the banner of the Samyukt Kisan Morcha (SKM) have announced plans to march toward Delhi on October 23, alongside simultaneous demonstrations across district, taluk, and block headquarters nationwide. According to statements from the All India Kisan Sabha (AIKS) and SKM leaders at a press conference in New Delhi, the participants are protesting the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls. They are demanding the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar, the cancellation of the SIR exercise, and modifications to the procedure for selecting election commissioners. Organisers stated that members of trade unions, student, youth, and women's organisations, as well as civil society groups, are expected to join the demonstrations.
demands: Resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar
Scrapping of the Special Intensive Revision of electoral rolls
Change in the selection process of election commissioners
response: No official response reported in the sources.

updates.text: SKM and AIKS leaders announced a march to Delhi and nationwide protests for October 23 against the CEC and electoral rolls revision.
